checkpoint.completed_scope: All 80 reviewed provider appearances are imported: 18 KayKit and 62 Kenney. Together with the original standard character, the formal catalog contains 81 characters and 312 four-slot wearable definitions.
checkpoint.command: uv run --locked python scripts/kenney-character-heads.py && uv run --locked python scripts/prepare-kenney-characters.py --all
checkpoint.resume_notes: Restore exact source archives from provider-pack-manifest.json; create reviewed head masks, prepare in an isolated workspace, verify actual GLB structure and bidirectional outfits, then merge only validated current assets. The original standard character and shared animation catalog are retained. --evidence rechecks existing entries rather than performing first-time preparation.

verification.structure: Actual GLTFLoader parses and assembles all 81 characters with default, Rogue, beard and reverse outfits. All 592 shipped GLB files have zero Khronos errors; NODE_SKINNED_MESH_NON_ROOT warnings are retained and checked by binding/loader/browser evidence.
verification.source_geometry: Real-source binding, head semantics, flat-face ray tests, prototype waist contact, full skeleton eye triangles and both canonical/native antenna contact checks passed.
verification.visual: Four-view source and mixed outfit batches, representative action samples and 34 final corrected groups reviewed. Five source profiles purchased, equipped, saved and reopened in Chromium and WebKit; all animation frames and every possible outfit combination were not exhaustively inspected.
